newsitem.title: UK: S&P puts GiroCredit ratings on watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts GiroCredit ratings on watch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it placed the A3 short term counterparty and certificates of deposit ratings of Austria's GiroCredit Bank AG on CreditWatch with developing implications.

"The rating action follows the announcement made on March 19, 1997 by First Austrian Bank that it had won support from its supervisory board to purchase 56.1 percent of ordinary share capital in GiroCredit from AV-Z, its holding company," the rating agency said in a statement.
It said the acquisition, which will create Austria's second-largest banking group, requires approval by the cartel authorities.
The A3 commercial paper rating of GiroCredit's unit, GiroCredit Finance Delaware Inc was also placed on CreditWatch with developing implications.
